description: Schema for sampling_freeze_summary.json; no test labels are stored here.

required_fields.c2_claims: integer, exactly 240 after a successful freeze
required_fields.c5_claims: integer, exactly 240 after a successful freeze
required_fields.claims: integer, exactly 480 after a successful freeze
required_fields.pre_test_text_correction: required reversible frozen-text-corrections-v1 audit: ledger hash/rows, exact pre/post candidate/human/frozen/screen/registry hashes, unchanged assignment hash and design identities, one authoritative frozen claim, zero formal responses, and rebuilt-but-not-distributed stage-1 counts

required_fields.source_replacement_summary_sha256: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 of the stable 77+3 replacement audit; required on the successful post-replacement freeze (the retained pre-apply replacement-required audit predates this artifact)
required_fields.sources: integer, exactly 80 after a successful freeze
